source.title: The Final Test
source.description: I should reveal my true purpose now, <name>. I believe this scythe can help put a stop to Des'Altek once and for all. Meet me at Demon Fall Canyon in Ashenvale so that we can use him as the final soul needed to restore the scythe to full power.
source.objective: Obtain Des'Altek's soul from Demon Fall Canyon and use it to finish restoring the scythe.
source.completion: Thank you for helping me, <name>. You have done well. Please keep the scythe as a token of my gratitude.
